title: Jeannie's Kickin' Fried Fish
description: These tilapia fillets, coated with crisp, light seasoned crumbs, pan-fry to a perfect golden brown in just a few minutes. The seasoning gives them a nice 'kick.'
ingredients: 1 pound tilapia fillets, rinsed and patted dry
0.5 cup Italian seasoned bread crumbs (such as Progresso®)
1 teaspoon blackened seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
0.25 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, or to taste
0.25 teaspoon freshly ground sea salt, or to taste

steps.text: Beat egg with milk in a shallow bowl. In another shallow bowl, mix bread crumbs, roasted onion flakes, garlic, blackened seasoning, crushed red pepper flakes, black pepper, and salt together until combined.

Dip a tilapia fillet into egg mixture, then press gently into crumb mixture on both sides; set the coated fillet onto a plate. Repeat with remaining fillets; refrigerate the coated fillets for about 15 minutes to help set the crumbs.

Heat olive oil and butter in a cast-iron frying pan over medium heat. Lay fillets in the skillet, and pan-fry until golden brown on each side, about 3 minutes per side. The fish should be opaque and flaky underneath the coating. Remove and drain fillets on paper towels.

video.description: In this video you'll see how to make a quick and easy fried fish. This version uses Cajun spices and seasoned breadcrumbs to make a crispy, flavorful crust. Fresh tilapia fillets hold up great here- but cod, halibut or even salmon would be equally delicious.
